decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Site Location and Block Plan received 27/10/2011, Schedule of Works and Planning Statement received 16/11/2011, 01A, 02A, 03A, 04B, 05B, 06C, 07B, 08A, 09B, 11A and 12 received 05/01/2012 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings to the minimum extent possible.

Condition : 4 - In the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands shall be retained to show the historical past of the building. Supporting beams shall be retained, and if changed because of rot, shall remain visible as a downstand. The nib shall have a minimum depth of 0.2m.
description: Listed building consent for alterations and additions to convert three household units back into a single family dwelling including erection of a single storey rear conservatory extension, erection a single a single storey side extension, changes to bin storage area, alterations to windows, new fencing, installation of roof lights and various other types of repairs and maintenance.
